name: Fractera Vectors
shortDescription: The vector store of the node: elements keep pieces of text as vectors in named collections and find the ones closest to a question, on a sqlite-vec nearest-neighbour index.
longDescription: The vector store of the node, split from the data layer in step 550. An element sends a text with the name of its collection; the store turns it into a vector with the node's OpenAI key (text-embedding-3-large, 3072 dimensions) or takes a ready vector, and finds the closest records to a question with an exact cosine score over the candidates of a sqlite-vec index partitioned by collection. A broken index never passes for a working one: the store drops to a linear scan and says so in /vectors/status. Consumers keep calling /vectors on the database element of the node, which passes the request here as it is.
accepts: The node data key (X-Data-Secret) or a privileged session; JSON bodies { collection, text, embedding?, refTable?, refId? } and { collection?, query | embedding, k? }.
returns: JSON: the stored record id, model and index mode; the nearest records with a score; the state of the store.
